title: Traffic & Revenue Estimation
description: About Business JOB DESCRIPTION Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.Adani RMRW: Encompassing Adani Road Transport Limited and Adani Water, Adani RMRW is a key infrastructure business of the Adani Group, focused on driving sustainable development. Adani Road Transport Limited specializes in the construction, operation, and maintenance of highways and expressways, ensuring seamless connectivity across India. Adani Water addresses critical water challenges through innovative projects such as desalination plants, water treatment facilities, and irrigation systems, enhancing water availability and sustainability. Together, these businesses aim to deliver world-class infrastructure while fostering environmental stewardship and community impact, making Adani RMRW a leader in India's infrastructure and resource management sector.Job PurposeResponsible for overseeing the accurate estimation of traffic volumes and revenue streams through advanced modeling techniques, leveraging historical data, real-time information, and market intelligence. Ensure the integrity of construction plans and cost estimations, maintaining high standards through rigorous quality audits. Lead the development and implementation of innovative traffic management systems, prioritizing safety and efficiency across all transportation projects.ResponsibilitiesTraffic Analysis and Forecasting:Analyze complex traffic data to identify trends and patterns that influence transportation planning and policy-making.Develop accurate traffic demand forecasts, considering potential diversion routes and the impact of external factors on traffic flow.Estimate toll revenues by analyzing traffic volumes and types, projecting future increases, and evaluating the effectiveness of tolling strategies.Conduct Traffic Volume Count Analysis to understand current usage patterns and predict future traffic flows.Analyze Origin/Destination and Commodity-related data to gain insights into traffic behavior and logistics trends.Forecast toll rates based on predetermined schedules and adjust for market conditions and policy changes.Estimate Growth Rates for traffic and revenue, considering economic indicators and regional development plans.Perform Traffic Diversion Analysis to evaluate the impact of changes in the transportation network on traffic distribution.Vendor CoordinationCoordinate the collection and dissemination of necessary inputs and data to consultants and vendors for the development of traffic models.Assist in the resolution of any issues or discrepancies in the information provided to ensure the accuracy of traffic models.Assess the potential impact of new developments, such as residential or commercial projects, on the existing transportation network and propose solutions to mitigate negative effects.Quality Assurance And Software ProficiencyScrutinize construction plans, design calculations, and cost estimations to verify their accuracy and ensure they meet engineering standards and project requirements.Perform quality audits on transportation projects to maintain high standards of construction and design integrity.Utilize specialized software tools, such as VISUM for traffic modeling and GIS for spatial analysis, to create detailed and predictive models of transportation networks.Translate complex
